tools.description: Take a compact text snapshot of an Anki Qt WebEngine CDP page, with Chrome DevTools-style uid refs for visible controls and content. Always use the latest snapshot before interacting by uid. If no target is supplied, Deckhand defaults to Anki's page titled main webview; use list_pages first when the intended page is ambiguous.

filePath.description: Write snapshot text to a local file and return metadata instead of attaching the full text.

host.description: Local CDP host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 and must be localhost.

pageId.description: Exact CDP page id from list_pages.

preferredTarget.description: How to choose a page when no explicit target selector is supplied. Default main prefers Anki's main webview; first chooses the first CDP page; strict fails if multiple pages are available.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring of the target page title.

urlContains.description: Substring that must appear in the target page URL.

verbose.description: Include more visible non-interactive content in the snapshot tree.

webSocketDebuggerUrl.description: Exact CDP page WebSocket URL from list_pages. Overrides all other target selectors.
